title: Hypnotically Inebriated (Video (Standard))
description: You like Drinking, and you like being Hypnotized. Then, why not Both. Drunk up. Enhance your feeling of being Drunk with Hypnosis. Breathe in. and relax. Levitate away from anxiety. Be happy. Have fun. Let intoxication drift you away from stress. Focus on how being tipsy makes you feel, the tingly happiness. Be one with the booze, travels around your bloodstream back into your brain, your Mind. DRIFT.
author: Mistress Shibby
